exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "have to / must (nai to ikenai)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～ないといけない matches "have to / must (nai to ikenai)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～ないといけない.
exercises.explanation: Expresses obligation; used to say you must or have to do something.
